data.name: LegendGroupSwitch
data.value: Show or hide every pen of group {0}

data.name: StatusConnectionRestoredTitle
data.value: The connection to the archive is restored

data.name: StatusConnectionRestoredDetail
data.value: SemiPlot is reading the archive again.

data.name: AxisScaleBoundInvalid
data.value: Enter a number in each field

data.name: AxisScaleMinimumBelowMaximum
data.value: The minimum must be below the maximum

data.name: EmptyCatalogueMessage
data.value: The pen catalogue is empty. Open {0} > {1}, press {2}, then name and switch on the pens you need.

data.name: FailureUnknownRemedy
data.value: Report the SemiPlot log file. It carries the full entry.

data.name: FailureThrownRemedy
data.value: Restart SemiPlot. If the failure repeats, report the SemiPlot log file.

data.name: FailureConnectionFileRejectedTitle
data.value: SemiPlot cannot read the archive connection settings

data.name: FailureConnectionFileRejectedRemedy
data.value: Correct the value the reason names in a file of that folder.

data.name: FailureConnectionFileUnparseableRemedy
data.value: Correct the syntax of the configuration file in that folder.

data.name: FailureConnectionFileMissingFieldRemedy
data.value: Every field is required. Add the field the reason names to a file in that folder.

data.name: FailureConnectionFileOutOfRangeRemedy
data.value: Correct the value the reason names to one inside the range it states.

data.name: FailureConnectionFileHostNotIPv4Remedy
data.value: Set the host to an IPv4 address of four numbers from 0 to 255, such as 127.0.0.1. A host name is not accepted.

data.name: FailureArchiveUnreachableDetail
data.value: SemiPlot could not open a connection to {0}.

data.name: FailureArchiveUnreachableRemedy
data.value: Check that the PostgreSQL server is running. Check that the host and port in the connection file are reachable from this machine. Check the route and the firewall.

data.name: FailureArchiveAccessDeniedDetail
data.value: The server at {0} answered, but refused user '{1}' access to '{2}'.

data.name: FailureArchiveAccessDeniedRemedy
data.value: Check the user name and password in the connection file. Check the grants SemiBase gives the role.

data.name: FailureArchiveDatabaseMissingDetail
data.value: The server at {0} answers, but holds no database '{1}'.

data.name: FailureArchiveDatabaseMissingRemedy
data.value: Run 'semibase site' against this server to create the database. Check the database name in the connection file.

data.name: FailureArchiveTableMissingRemedy
data.value: '{0}' is created by provisioning. Run 'semibase site' against this database to finish provisioning it.

data.name: FailureArchiveConnectionLostDetail
data.value: The archive {0} stopped answering after {1} consecutive failed reads. The history already drawn is unaffected.

data.name: FailureArchiveConnectionLostRemedy
data.value: SemiPlot keeps reading and clears this message once the archive answers. Check that the PostgreSQL server is running. Check that it is reachable from this machine.

data.name: FailureArchiveShapeUnexpectedTitle
data.value: The archive has an unexpected structure

data.name: FailureArchiveShapeUnexpectedDetail
data.value: The archive {0} is missing columns SemiPlot reads. The server answered: {1}

data.name: FailureArchiveShapeUnexpectedRemedy
data.value: Table 'public.trends' and its columns are created by provisioning. Run 'semibase site' against this database. Check whether anything has altered the table since.

data.name: FailureArchiveQueryTimedOutDetail
data.value: The server ended a statement against {0} (SQLSTATE 57014).

data.name: FailureArchiveQueryTimedOutRemedy
data.value: Check statement_timeout for the role on the server. If the chart was reading, narrow its time window. Check whether an administrator cancelled the statement.

data.name: FailureArchiveReadFailedRemedy
data.value: Find the entry for SQLSTATE {0} in the PostgreSQL server log. Report it with the SemiPlot log file.

data.name: FailureArchiveReadUnnamedDetail
data.value: A statement against {0} failed before the server answered.

data.name: FailureArchiveReadUnnamedRemedy
data.value: If this message repeats, report the SemiPlot log file.

data.name: FailureArchiveValueRejectedDetail
data.value: The archive {0} refused the value written to pen '{1}'.

data.name: FailureArchiveValueRejectedRemedy
data.value: Enter another value. The initial scale takes both bounds with the minimum below the maximum. A colour takes the form #RRGGBB.

data.name: FailureArchiveNameTakenDetail
data.value: The archive {0} already holds a group named '{1}'.

data.name: FailureArchiveNameTakenRemedy
data.value: Choose a name no other group carries.

data.name: FailureArchiveRowGoneDetail
data.value: The archive {0} no longer holds '{1}'. Another SemiPlot instance or an administrator removed it.

data.name: FailureArchiveRowGoneRemedy
data.value: Read the catalogue again to see what it holds now. Repeat the edit if it still applies.

data.name: FailureStartupReadTimedOutTitle
data.value: The archive did not answer in time

data.name: FailureStartupReadTimedOutDetail
data.value: SemiPlot received no answer to the first read of the {0} within {1} s and stopped waiting.

data.name: FailureStartupReadTimedOutRemedy
data.value: Check the load on the server. Check that the archive is indexed on its time column.

data.name: FailureAppSettingsRejectedTitle
data.value: SemiPlot cannot read the interface settings

data.name: FailureAppSettingsUnreadableDetail
data.value: SemiPlot read the interface settings folder '{0}' but could not parse its files.

data.name: FailureAppSettingsUnreadableRemedy
data.value: Give the account running SemiPlot read access to that folder. Correct the syntax of the files in it.

data.name: FailureAppSettingsKeyMissingDetail
data.value: The interface settings folder '{0}' carries no '{1}' key.

data.name: FailureAppSettingsKeyMissingRemedy
data.value: Both keys 'locale' and 'theme' are required. Add the missing key to a '*.yaml' file in that folder.

data.name: FailureAppSettingsValueInvalidDetail
data.value: The key '{1}' in the interface settings folder '{0}' holds a value outside its set. Accepted values: {2}.

data.name: FailureAppSettingsValueInvalidRemedy
data.value: Set that key to one of the accepted values. Restart SemiPlot.

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionAppTitle
data.value: SemiPlot cannot read the interface settings folder

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionConnectionTitle
data.value: SemiPlot cannot read the archive connection folder

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionDirectoryMissingDetail
data.value: SemiPlot did not find the configuration folder '{0}'.

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionNoFilesDetail
data.value: The configuration folder '{0}' holds no '*.yaml' file.

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionUnreadableDetail
data.value: SemiPlot could not read or parse the file '{1}' in the configuration folder '{0}'.

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionUnlistableDetail
data.value: SemiPlot could not list the files of the configuration folder '{0}'.

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionKeyConflictDetail
data.value: The key '{0}' is set in both files '{1}' and '{2}' of the configuration folder '{3}'.

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionDuplicateKeyDetail
data.value: The key '{0}' is set twice in the file '{1}' of the configuration folder '{2}'.

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionAppDirectoryMissingRemedy
data.value: Create that folder with a '*.yaml' file carrying a 'locale' key and a 'theme' key. Or start SemiPlot with the --config-dir argument naming the folder that holds it.

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionConnectionDirectoryMissingRemedy
data.value: Create that folder with a '*.yaml' file carrying the archive connection fields. Or start SemiPlot with the --config-dir argument naming the folder that holds it.

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionAppNoFilesRemedy
data.value: Add a '*.yaml' file carrying a 'locale' key and a 'theme' key to that folder.

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionConnectionNoFilesRemedy
data.value: Add a '*.yaml' file carrying the archive connection fields to that folder.

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionUnreadableRemedy
data.value: Give the account running SemiPlot read access to that folder. Correct the syntax of the files in it.

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionKeyConflictRemedy
data.value: Only one file of a folder may carry a key. Remove that key from one of the two files.

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionDuplicateKeyRemedy
data.value: A key may be set once in a folder. Leave one of them in that file.

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionUnwritableDetail
data.value: SemiPlot could not write the file '{1}' in the configuration folder '{0}'.

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionKeyAbsentDetail
data.value: No file of the configuration folder '{1}' carries the key '{0}'.

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionUnwritableRemedy
data.value: Give the account running SemiPlot write access to that folder and its files. Close any program that holds the file open, then save again.

data.name: FailureConfigurationSectionKeyAbsentRemedy
data.value: Add that key back to one file of the folder, then save again.

data.name: FailureStartupArgumentsTitle
data.value: SemiPlot was started with wrong arguments

data.name: FailureStartupArgumentsMissingDetail
data.value: SemiPlot was started without the required argument '{0}'.

data.name: FailureStartupArgumentsMissingRemedy
data.value: All three arguments --config-dir, --log-file and --logging-level are required. Add the missing one with its value to the SemiPlot shortcut.

data.name: FailureStartupArgumentsValueMissingDetail
data.value: The argument '{0}' was given without a value.

data.name: FailureStartupArgumentsValueMissingRemedy
data.value: Put a value after that argument in the SemiPlot shortcut.

data.name: FailureStartupArgumentsUnknownDetail
data.value: SemiPlot does not know the argument '{0}'.

data.name: FailureStartupArgumentsUnknownRemedy
data.value: SemiPlot reads only --config-dir, --log-file and --logging-level. Remove that argument from the SemiPlot shortcut.

data.name: FailureStartupArgumentsValueInvalidDetail
data.value: The argument '{0}' holds a value outside its set. Accepted values: {1}.

data.name: FailureStartupArgumentsValueInvalidRemedy
data.value: Set that argument to one of the accepted values in the SemiPlot shortcut.

data.name: FailureInstanceHostUnknownTitle
data.value: SemiPlot could not start another window

data.name: FailureInstanceHostUnknownDetail
data.value: The executable of the running process is unknown, so a copy of SemiPlot cannot be started.

data.name: FailureInstanceHostUnknownRemedy
data.value: Close this window and start SemiPlot from its shortcut.

data.name: FailureLogFileTitle
data.value: SemiPlot could not open its log file

data.name: FailureLogFileDetail
data.value: The file '{0}' named by the --log-file argument could not be opened for writing: {1}

data.name: FailureLogFileRemedy
data.value: The path has to name a file in an existing folder that is writable. Check the path the --log-file argument gives in the SemiPlot shortcut.

data.name: SettingsRestartNotice

data.value: Saved. Theme applied, the rest after a restart.

data.name: SettingsPollIntervalInvalid
data.value: Poll interval: a whole number above 0

data.name: SettingsSectionUnreadable
data.value: {0}: a file cannot be read. The message panel names it.

data.name: SettingsKeyAbsent
data.value: Key '{0}': no file of its section carries it. Add it to a file by hand.

data.value: Initial scale: set both bounds or neither

data.value: Delete group '{0}'? Pens in the group: {1}. The pens themselves stay.
